'''Joan Rand Moschovakis''' is a [[logic]]ian and [[mathematician]] focusing on [[intuitionistic logic]] and mathematics.  She is professor emerita at [[Occidental College]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.oxy.edu/faculty/joan-rand-moschovakis|title=Joan Rand Moschovakis - Occidental College - The Liberal Arts College in Los Angeles|work=oxy.edu|date=2018-10-03}}</ref> and a guest at [[UCLA]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.ucla.edu/~joan/|title=Joan Moschovakis|work=ucla.edu}}</ref>

Moschovakis earned her [[Ph.D.]] from the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] in 1965 under the direction of [[Stephen Kleene]], with a dissertation titled ''Disjunction, Existence and *-Eliminability in Formalized Intuitionistic Analysis''.

Moschovakis is married to [[Yiannis N. Moschovakis|Yiannis Moschovakis]], with whom she gave the 2014 [[Per Lindström|Lindström]] Lectures at the [[University of Gothenburg]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://flov.gu.se/english/research/logic/lindstrom-lectures|title=The Lindström Lectures - Department of Philosophy, Linguistics and Theory of Science, University of Gothenburg, Sweden|work=University of Gothenburg|access-date=2015-08-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161029062947/http://flov.gu.se/english/research/logic/lindstrom-lectures|archive-date=2016-10-29|url-status=dead}}</ref>
